instruction: Create a Part workbench box sized 38 mm along global X, 26 mm along global Y, and 18 mm along global Z, with its lower-back-left corner at the origin so it spans X = 0 to 38, Y = 0 to 26, and Z = 0 to 18. Remove the top face at Z = 18, then apply Part Thickness with wall thickness 2 mm inward to make an open-top rectangular shell. The shell should keep the outside dimensions 38 mm by 26 mm by 18 mm, have 2 mm thick walls and bottom, and have an interior cavity opening upward. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
